does_not_do: It does not review or test the tools it links, and its own wording ranks some of them.
focus_reason: A broad map for the need, updated 2026-11-03; as a link list it inherits the quality of whatever it points to.
measured_against: Need: a reading map of DeFi development tools and research.
tests_ci: Not applicable: a curated list of links, with no code to test.
what_it_is: A community-maintained handbook of links to DeFi and blockchain development tools, research and references, translated into several languages.
